name: Accredited Employer Work Visa (AEWV)

qualifying_event.description: For migrants with a job offer from a New Zealand employer that is accredited with Immigration New Zealand and has an approved Job Check for the specific position.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Job offer/employment agreement; employer's accreditation and approved Job Check; identity and (where required) qualification/experience evidence.

requirements.blocker_text: The employer must hold current AEWV accreditation and an approved Job Check for the specific role.

As of March 2025 the general median-wage pay floor was removed for standard AEWV jobs; pay must instead be at least NZ minimum wage and on par with what NZ workers doing the same job are paid ('market rate'), assessed occupation-by-occupation via Immigration New Zealand's wage-rate tool.
The job must offer at least 30 hours of work per week with the specific accredited employer, job, and location listed on the visa; a second job is not permitted.

evidence_required.document: Employer's accreditation and Job Check approval

outcome.duration_length: up to 5 years for most occupations; up to 3 years for ANZSCO skill levels 4-5

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand -- Accredited Employer Work Visa: employer accreditation and Job Check requirement, occupation-specific market-rate pay (median-wage floor removed March 2025), 30 hrs/week minimum, single-employer/job/location restriction, up to 5-year (or 3-year, skill level 4-5) duration

livinginnz.co.nz -- confirms the 'general' AEWV median-wage requirement was removed in 2025 in favour of market rates, while the NZD 35.00/hour median wage (effective 9 March 2026) continues to govern Skilled Migrant Category points, Green List Residence, and Parent Category thresholds

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (New Zealand). AEWV pay policy has been genuinely volatile: a flat median-wage threshold applied historically, was removed in March 2025 in favour of occupation-specific 'market rate' pay (confirmed directly on the tier-1 page's current wording), while the median wage itself (now NZD 35.00/hour as of 9 March 2026 per tier-3 reporting) continues to apply to OTHER categories -- see nz_skilled_migrant_category.json. A separately-referenced 2x-2024-median-wage figure (NZD 67.12/hour) for skipping skill-requirement verification appears stale on the official page (still labelled '2024 median wage') and was not modeled as a current hard figure. pr_after_months left null since this visa itself does not directly grant residence -- see nz_skilled_migrant_category.json for the points-based residence pathway it feeds into.
